name: product-hunt
description: Discover and compare software, research recent startups, and manage Product Hunt launches.

interface.longDescription:
Discover and research software using more than a decade of Product Hunt launch history. Compare tools using community ratings and reviews, browse past leaderboards, and shortlist recent startups for investment research.

Built something new? Found a tool the world needs to know about? Share it with the Product Hunt community. Create and manage launches and hunts right from your assistant.
defaultPrompt: Find alternatives to Calendly and compare their ratings.
Shortlist AI agent startups from last month for investment research.
Help me prepare my Product Hunt launch.

positive.prompt: Compare alternatives to Calendly using Product Hunt ratings and community reviews.
positive.expected_behavior: Compare returned products using ratings and review evidence. Include Product Hunt links.

positive.prompt: Who makes Linear, is it free, and what do reviewers think?
positive.expected_behavior: Summarize makers, pricing type, and reviews from the response. Identify unavailable details.

positive.description: Sign in and grant account access when prompted.
positive.prompt: Find investable AI agent startups launched in Q3 2026.
positive.expected_behavior: Show returned startups in rank order with links and exact Series A bands. Explain bands as relative rankings. Report empty results honestly.

positive.prompt: What were the top three launches in October 2026?
positive.expected_behavior: Show the returned products in official rank order with links.

positive.description: Reviewer account needs a draft with missing requirements and launch read access.
positive.prompt: Is my newest draft ready to submit? Leave it as is.
positive.tools_triggered: list_my_launches(status="draft", limit=1), then get_launch(launch_id from response).
positive.expected_behavior: Report blockers and optional suggestions from the assessment. Make no changes.

negative.description: Explain that voting is unsupported. get_product_profile may provide a link to Linear. No vote may be cast. The assistant may offer to send feedback. The prompt grants no consent to call submit_feedback. Call no write tools.

Explain that draft deletion is unsupported. With the reviewer account connected, list_my_launches may identify the draft. No draft may be changed, submitted, or deleted. The assistant may offer to send feedback. The prompt grants no consent to call submit_feedback. Call no write tools.

Explain that the plugin cannot send email. get_product_profile may identify Linear’s makers. No message may be sent to the makers. The assistant may offer to send feedback. The prompt grants no consent to call submit_feedback. Call no write tools.
negative.prompt: Email Linear’s makers for a demo.

publication.release_notes: Sign in with your Product Hunt account to manage your launches. Create and preview drafts, check what’s missing, submit your launch, and edit or reschedule existing launches. You can also choose to send feedback to the Product Hunt team.
